name: Oshikake! Entremets
source:
This is Kamille’s debut game. Nagayoshi is great at housework and likes sweet things. One day when he was deciding on what to do in the future, his parents decided to go to France for training, entrusting him with running the family cafe Large. Of course he couldn’t do this by himself, so his parents got him some help. However, not only are Renon and Sunao going to work with him, they are both vying to be his bride! His childhood friend Wako who also has feelings for him hears about this, declares herself a candidate as well and moves in with them.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是Kamille的處女作。永吉擅長家務，也喜歡甜食。一天，他正在思考未來時，父母決定前往法國進修，並把家裡經營的咖啡館Large交給他打理。當然，他不可能獨自完成這些工作，於是父母替他找來了幫手。然而，蕾儂與直不但要和他一起工作，還都想成為他的新娘！同樣喜歡永吉的青梅竹馬和子聽說此事後，也宣布加入這場新娘爭奪戰，搬來跟他們同住。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
